contracts.title: Complex manifolds, holomorphic bundles and observations
contracts.supplied: Complex inverse/implicit-function and tangent calculus; holomorphic germs and one-variable meromorphic germs; holomorphic bundle/sheaf equivalence and nonsingular flat connections/local systems; projective charts.
contracts.owned_here: N owns nonlinear connections, holomorphic ODEs, transport and observations. M owns meromorphic/analytic-moduli comparisons. K4 does not supply algebraic analytification.
contracts.supplied_ja: 複素逆・陰関数と接束計算、正則芽・一変数有理型芽、正則束と層の同値、非特異な平坦接続と局所系、射影空間のチャート。非線形接続と正則ODEはN部、解析化と有理型比較はM部が担う。

contracts.title: Smooth bundle and connection foundations
contracts.supplied: Smooth Ehresmann splittings, proper-submersion and principal-connection transport within their respective hypotheses.
contracts.owned_here: N1.1–N1.5 own nonlinear connection objects, continuous-time local lifting, holomorphic parameter dependence and complete nonlinear transport. No properness of the phase projection is assumed.
contracts.supplied_ja: 滑らかなEhresmann分裂、固有沈め込みおよび主接続の移送を、それぞれの仮定の範囲で用いる。一般の非線形移送はN1.1–N1.5が担う。

contracts.title: Smooth differential calculus and flows
contracts.supplied: Finite-dimensional manifolds, charts and smooth local/maximal/time-dependent flows.
contracts.owned_here: N1.2 proves the continuous-time locally uniformly Lipschitz theorem; N1.8 constructs intrinsic jets; N1.9 proves finite-chart stability and no exit.
contracts.supplied_ja: 有限次元多様体・チャート・滑らかな局所／極大／時間依存flow。連続時間・相変数局所一様Lipschitzの定理はN1.2、一階jetはN1.8、有限チャートの収束はN1.9で証明する。

contracts.title: Covering spaces and universal covers
contracts.supplied: Native covering, path and homotopy lifting, universal covers and their fundamental-group interfaces.
contracts.owned_here: N1.5 constructs the nonlinear action and horizontal descent; general-cover descent uses the actual fiber relation, not deck invariance without normality.
contracts.supplied_ja: 既存の被覆・経路とホモトピーの持上げ・普遍被覆・基本群。非線形作用と水平降下はN1.5で構成し、非正規被覆では実際のファイバー関係を用いる。

contracts.title: Marked-curve charts
contracts.supplied: Genus-zero Möbius normalization and supported point-pushing; stable marked-curve deformation charts in the stable range.
contracts.owned_here: M1.2 constructs unstable one-/two-pointed quotient charts, finite jets, local markings and determinant transport. Its analytic category is constructed there; D2.0 is only an instance comparison.
contracts.supplied_ja: 種数0のMöbius正規化と点の移動、安定範囲の標識曲線変形チャート。1・2標点の商チャート、有限jet、局所標識、行列式移送はM1.2が構成する。

contracts.title: Stacks, inertia and restricted coarse-space criteria
contracts.supplied: Stackification, 2-fiber products, algebraic/DM presentations, inertia, QCoh descent, and finite-inertia Keel–Mori at its hypotheses.
contracts.owned_here: M2.1 proves bounded GIT, scalar Gm rigidification, gerbe and coarse comparisons. Finite-inertia criteria do not apply to an unrigidified Gm stable stack.
contracts.supplied_ja: スタック化・2ファイバー積・慣性・準連接層降下・有限慣性のKeel–Mori。Gmの剛化、GIT、gerbeと粗モジュライの比較はM2.1が証明する。

contracts.title: Quotient predicates
contracts.supplied: Categorical/geometric quotient definitions, Artin bootstrap and the stated finite-group projective quotients.
contracts.owned_here: Reductive invariant theory and actual character quotients are M2.1/M4.1; wild framing and Stokes quotients are P4.2.
contracts.supplied_ja: 圏論的商・幾何学的商の定義と明記された有限群商。簡約群の不変式と指標商はM2.1/M4.1、Stokesの商はP4.2で構成する。

contracts.title: Quot/Hilbert and parameter schemes
contracts.supplied: Noetherian projective Quot/Hilbert and Hom/Isom parameter spaces with their stated base-change laws.
contracts.owned_here: M2.1 proves boundedness, the equations and stability/GIT comparison. Analytic pullbacks use M1.2.
contracts.supplied_ja: Noetherian・射影的なQuot/HilbertとHom/Isom空間。接続の有界性・方程式・安定性はM2.1、解析的引戻しはM1.2が担う。

contracts.title: Cohomology, duality and curve degree
contracts.supplied: Čech and sheaf cohomology, coherent terms, relative/Serre duality, degrees and curve Riemann–Roch at the stated hypotheses.
contracts.owned_here: M2.2 constructs C-linear differential-operator hypercohomology and the ramified cone; coherent underlying terms do not make its differential O-linear.
contracts.supplied_ja: Čech・層コホモロジー、連接な項、相対・Serre双対、次数・曲線Riemann–Roch。ℂ線形微分作用素の全複体と分岐の錐はM2.2が構成する。

contracts.title: Elementary deformation theory
contracts.supplied: Artinian coefficients, deformation functors, hulls and elementary small-extension obstruction calculations.
contracts.owned_here: M2.2 constructs actual connection cocycles, the needed arbitrary finite square-zero kernels and framed versality; M3.1 constructs strong horizontal extensions.
contracts.supplied_ja: Artin係数・変形関手・hull・基本的小拡大の障害。実際の接続コサイクルと平方零核・versal比較はM2.2、強い水平延長はM3.1で証明する。

contracts.title: Algebraic vector bundles and finite locally free sheaves
contracts.supplied: Finite locally free sheaves, duals/tensors/determinants, relative Spec and the geometric vector-bundle equivalence.
contracts.owned_here: Meromorphic connections and analytification are M1.1–M1.2; relative dual Poisson geometry is C1.2.
contracts.supplied_ja: 有限局所自由層、双対・テンソル・行列式、相対Specと幾何学的ベクトル束との同値。接続と解析化はM1.1–M1.2、相対Poisson構成はC1.2が担う。

contracts.title: Coherent analytic module sheaves
contracts.supplied: Coherent analytic module-sheaf carriers and local calculus on the supplied analytic manifold structure sheaf.
contracts.owned_here: M1.2 constructs general complex analytic spaces, nilpotent quotients, analytification and GAGA comparisons.
contracts.supplied_ja: 与えられた解析多様体の構造層上の連接解析加群。冪零元を含む一般複素解析空間、解析化、GAGA比較はM1.2が構成する。

contracts.title: Proper coherent direct images and base change
contracts.supplied: Proper coherent pushforwards and separately stated flat-base-change and cohomology/base-change criteria; Grauert under its reduced-base and constant-rank assumptions.
contracts.owned_here: M2.3 proves the relative Picard extension; P6.3 verifies boundary-coefficient flatness and the exact locally free/arbitrary-base-change criterion.
contracts.supplied_ja: 固有連接直像と、各仮定を区別した平坦基底変換・コホモロジー基底変換。相対Picard拡張はM2.3、境界係数と任意基底変換の検証はP6.3が担う。

contracts.title: Picard over a field and Picard foundations
contracts.supplied: Picard representability for projective geometrically integral schemes over a field, smooth-curve Jacobians, line-bundle descent and deformation.
contracts.owned_here: M2.3 constructs relative Picard under projective flat finite presentation and universal functions, including nonreduced curves; P6.1 verifies its boundary hypotheses.
contracts.supplied_ja: 体上の射影的幾何学的整スキームのPicard、滑らかな曲線のJacobian、線束降下・変形。非被約曲線を含む相対PicardはM2.3が構成する。

contracts.title: Cohomology with supports
contracts.supplied: Supported cohomology, localization/excision and the Noetherian colimit-of-Ext comparison with native local cohomology.
contracts.owned_here: P6.3 constructs its first boundary layer, injection and time-line comparison; it does not identify all supported cohomology with that line.
contracts.supplied_ja: 台付きコホモロジー、局所化・切除、NoetherianなExt余極限との比較。第一境界層・注入・時間直線はP6.3が構成する。

contracts.title: Divisors, modifications and surface intersections
contracts.supplied: Divisor/Picard groups, blowups and strict transforms, normal crossings, surface intersection/adjunction and lattice theory.
contracts.owned_here: P6.1–P6.3 construct the nonreduced anticanonical boundary, relative logarithmic deformation and family comparisons; P7 constructs the geometric transformations.
contracts.supplied_ja: 因子・Picard群、ブローアップ・狭義変換、正規交叉、曲面交点・随伴・格子。非被約境界と相対変形はP6、変換はP7が担う。

contracts.title: Formal scalar and vector-valued Laurent algebra
sections: L5–L6 for finite-extension steps in M1.1
contracts.supplied: Formal substitutions, continuous differentials, finite-dimensional HahnModule comparisons, residue/duality, ramified exponent embeddings and the stated finite-extension algebra.
contracts.owned_here: M1.1 proves differential-module Levelt–Turrittin/descent; C1.1 proves the convergent-germ and compact-uniform cancellation adapter. Formal valuation convergence is not analytic convergence.
contracts.supplied_ja: 形式代入・連続微分・有限次元HahnModule・留数・分岐と有限拡大の代数。微分加群標準形はM1.1、収束芽の極相殺と一様極限はC1.1が証明する。

contracts.title: Native complex Fredholm and determinant carriers
contracts.supplied: Scalar-generic finite-dimensional kernel/cokernel, stabilization coordinates and pointwise determinant-line comparisons; specialize over ℂ and dualize the convention.
contracts.owned_here: A1.1 constructs the holomorphic family, canonical section, transition cocycle and base-change laws.
contracts.supplied_ja: 体を複素数に特殊化できる核・余核・安定化と各点の行列式線。双対規約を用い、正則な族・標準切断・コサイクルはA1.1が構成する。

contracts.title: Native analytic inversion
contracts.supplied: Analytic inversion on units of a complete normed algebra and the small-norm inverse.
contracts.owned_here: A1.1 and A1.3 prove the actual family-to-operator maps and uniform estimates.
contracts.supplied_ja: 完備ノルム代数の可逆元における解析的逆写像。実際の族から作用素への写像と一様評価はA1.1/A1.3で証明する。

contracts.title: Native Lp, Fourier and integral calculus
sections: Hölder and dominated convergence on the native measure/integral carrier
contracts.supplied: Native complex Lp spaces, Fourier–Plancherel, Hölder inequalities and integral convergence.
contracts.owned_here: A1.2 constructs contour measure/coordinate comparisons; A1.4 proves weighted moment and uniform-tail statements.
contracts.supplied_ja: 既存の複素Lp、Fourier–Plancherel、Hölder不等式、積分収束。積分路の比較はA1.2、重み付きモーメントと裾の一様性はA1.4が担う。

contracts.title: Real-line Hilbert transform
contracts.supplied: The real-line Cauchy/Hilbert multiplier −i sign(ξ), with L² norm one.
contracts.owned_here: A1.2 proves finite-arc/ray transport, the weighted cross-branch Schur bound, Plemelj and endpoint reconstruction.
contracts.supplied_ja: 実直線のHilbert変換とL²ノルム1の乗算子表示。分岐間の重み付きSchur評価・Plemelj・端点復元はA1.2が証明する。

contracts.title: Native contour and Schur foundations
contracts.supplied: Cauchy integral formula for the stated native contours and unweighted integral-kernel estimates.
contracts.owned_here: A1.2 proves its full contour package; the 1/(s+t) vertex kernel requires the weighted theorem specified there.
contracts.supplied_ja: 指定された既存積分路のCauchy公式と重みなしSchur評価。1/(s+t)の頂点核に必要な重み付き定理はA1.2が証明する。

contracts.title: Trace-class ideal carrier
contracts.supplied: Normed complete trace-class ideal, nuclear gauge and two-sided ideal estimates.
contracts.owned_here: A1.6 constructs the holomorphic-family adapter; P8.2 verifies actual trace-class realizations where used.
contracts.supplied_ja: 完備なトレースクラス・イデアルとノルム評価。正則族はA1.6、実際のRHPからの実現はP8.2が担う。

contracts.title: Generic trace-class determinant
contracts.supplied: Trace, exterior powers, generic Fredholm determinant series and trace-norm continuity before the positive-kernel point-process specialization.
contracts.owned_here: A1.6 proves holomorphic dependence and uniform convergence. P8.3 proves its actual logarithmic derivative and integrable-kernel comparison.
contracts.supplied_ja: 正の核への特殊化以前の一般的なトレース・外冪・Fredholm行列式級数・トレースノルム連続性。正則依存はA1.6、変分比較はP8.3で証明する。

contracts.title: Matrix-symbol Toeplitz index
contracts.supplied: Circle Hardy models and Fredholm index equal to minus determinant winding for continuous invertible matrix symbols.
contracts.owned_here: P8.2 constructs contour/Hardy, holomorphic-family, index-zero, resonant and ramified adapters. Index zero alone does not imply invertibility.
contracts.supplied_ja: 円周Hardy模型と可逆行列記号の指数＝行列式回転数の負。P8.2が実際の積分路・正則族・共鳴・分岐の比較を構成する。

contracts.title: Native Rouché and zero counts
contracts.supplied: Disc and null-homologous piecewise C¹ contour Rouché theorems and zero multiplicities.
contracts.owned_here: A1.6 supplies the actual boundary cycle and winding characterization for its general domain theorem.
contracts.supplied_ja: 円板・零ホモローグな区分的C¹閉曲線のRouchéと零点重複度。一般領域の境界サイクルと回転数はA1.6で構成する。

contracts.title: Native convergent meromorphic germs
contracts.supplied: Scalar convergent meromorphic germs, finite principal parts and holomorphic remainders.
contracts.owned_here: C1.1 supplies finite-dimensional coefficient comparison, the cancellation identity and compact-uniform parameter limits.
contracts.supplied_ja: スカラーの収束有理型芽・有限主要部・正則剰余。有限次元係数と極相殺・パラメータ一様極限はC1.1が担う。

contracts.title: Native meromorphic functions on Riemann surfaces
sections: Nonconstant curve pullback and order comparison
contracts.supplied: Holomorphic maps from a Riemann surface to OnePoint ℂ with a witness excluding the constant-infinity map; native pullback and orders.
contracts.owned_here: N1.7 proves phase-observation admissibility and scalar descent; its scalar output uses this same carrier.
contracts.supplied_ja: Riemann面からOnePoint ℂへの正則写像と恒等的無限大を除く証人、引戻し・位数。相空間の観測許容性とスカラー降下はN1.7が証明し、同じ関数の対象を用いる。

contracts.title: Smooth real linear Poisson signs
contracts.supplied: Positive/negative real Lie–Poisson conventions and fiber-negation comparison.
contracts.owned_here: C1.2 constructs the complex relative O_B-Lie and symmetric-algebra bracket, residue pairing and base change.
contracts.supplied_ja: 実Lie–Poissonの正負規約とファイバー符号反転。複素相対括弧・留数対・基底変換はC1.2が構成する。

contracts.title: Smooth real KKS and regular reduction
contracts.supplied: Smooth real coadjoint/KKS geometry and regular free proper Hamiltonian reduction.
contracts.owned_here: P11.1 proves actual complex quotient existence, orbit flatness and collision comparisons; C1.2 transports already verified data.
contracts.supplied_ja: 実滑らかなKKSと正則・自由・固有なHamilton簡約。複素商の存在・軌道の平坦性・衝突の比較はP11.1が証明する。

contracts.title: Airy, Fredholm and Hastings–McLeod theory
contracts.supplied: Airy normalization and tails, scalar Hastings–McLeod existence/uniqueness, real pole-freeness and F1/F2 identities.
contracts.owned_here: P10.4 constructs the intrinsic phase-point/jet bridge. P10.3 proves its tau normalization, sectorial calibration and selected connection constants.
contracts.supplied_ja: Airyの正規化と裾、Hastings–McLeod解の存在一意性・実軸上の無極性・F1/F2恒等式。内在的な解への橋渡しはP10.4、接続定数はP10.3が担う。

contracts.title: Native Gamma, Bernoulli and analytic carriers
contracts.supplied: Gamma and its pole-free analytic theory, Euler–Mascheroni constant, Bernoulli coefficients and native complex analysis.
contracts.owned_here: A1.7 constructs Barnes G, canonical normalization, zero divisor, logarithm branches and the explicit sectorial remainder.
contracts.supplied_ja: 既存Gammaと極を除く解析理論、Euler定数、Bernoulli係数。Barnes G・標準正規化・零因子・枝・明示剰余はA1.7で構成する。

contracts.title: Native topological properness
contracts.supplied: Topological proper maps and the compact-preimage and base-change properties under their actual topological hypotheses.
contracts.owned_here: N1.4 proves complete-lift transfer. M1.2 proves analytic/algebraic comparison; P4.4 proves properness of the actual RH family.
contracts.supplied_ja: 位相的固有写像と各仮定の下でのコンパクト逆像・基底変換。水平延長はN1.4、解析比較はM1.2、RH族の固有性はP4.4が証明する。

contracts.title: Native real Frobenius product coordinates
contracts.supplied: For a finite-dimensional real integrable graph field, a local product OpenPartialHomeomorph with a smooth inverse and the prescribed horizontal derivatives, at the stated regularity.
contracts.owned_here: N1.5 constructs the submersion-chart graph field, proves curvature implies its integrability, and glues these local products for homotopy-invariant transport. N1.3 supplies the holomorphic counterpart.
contracts.supplied_ja: 有限次元の実可積分グラフ場から、明記した正則性の下で、滑らかな逆写像と水平微分を持つ局所積OpenPartialHomeomorphを得る。N1.5が沈め込み座標への移送、曲率から可積分性、貼合せとホモトピー不変性を証明し、正則版はN1.3を用いる。

contracts.title: Chow lemma for the proper GAGA proof
contracts.supplied: For a separated finite-type morphism to a Noetherian base, a projective modification with quasi-projective source over that base; the source is projective when the original morphism is proper.
contracts.owned_here: M1.2 uses this subtarget with coherent cohomology and proper direct images for the proper GAGA argument. The separate flattening and StableReduction branch of 4.12 is not a prerequisite.
contracts.supplied_ja: Noetherian基底への有限型分離射に対し、基底上準射影的となる射影的改変を供給し、元の射が固有なら改変後は基底上射影的となる。M1.2はこの小目標と連接コホモロジー・固有直像をGAGAの証明に用い、4.12の別の平坦化・StableReductionの分岐は前提にしない。
